units.title: Tangential quadrilaterals force additivity
units.statement: If f on positive reals satisfies f(a+b+c+d)=f(a)+f(b)+f(c)+f(d) for every tangential quadrilateral, then squares give f(4t)=4f(t), while tangential kites with sides x,y,y,x give midpoint Jensen. Together these imply f(2t)=2f(t), hence f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y). Consequently f(p/q)=p f(1)/q for positive integers p,q.
steps: Apply the identity to squares and tangential kites
Use additivity to evaluate positive rational arguments
